schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.summary: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families across India in three equal installments of ₹2,000.
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares. Institutional landholders and high-income taxpayers excluded.
schemes.application_process: Apply via pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar card, land documents, and bank account details.

schemes.name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
schemes.summary: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks like drought, flood, pests, and storms.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
schemes.benefits: Max premium payable by farmer: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. Balance subsidized by Govt.
schemes.application_process: Enroll through bank branch, insurance agent, pmfby.gov.in, or CSC before the cutoff date for notified crops.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.summary: Provides timely short-term credit to farmers and fishermen for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and maintenance of fishing equipment/boats.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, self-help groups, individual fishermen, boat owners, and fish farmers.
schemes.benefits: Concessional interest rate at 7% per annum. 3% prompt repayment incentive brings effective interest to 4%. Credit limit up to ₹3 Lakhs without collateral.
schemes.application_process: Fill KCC form at any commercial bank, RRB, or Cooperative Bank branch with KYC and land/boat ownership proof.

schemes.name: PMMSY (Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana)
schemes.summary: Flagship scheme for sustainable development of fisheries sector, safety of fishermen at sea, boat modernization, and fish marketing infrastructure.
schemes.eligibility: Fishermen, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors, self-help groups, fisheries cooperatives.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance up to 40% (General Category) to 60% (SC/ST/Women) for buying modern fishing boats, GPS/communication safety equipment, fish seeds, and ice boxes.
schemes.application_process: Apply through State Fisheries Department portal or District Fisheries Officer (DFO).
documents_required: Fisherman Identity Card / Boat Registration Certificate

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.summary: Provides crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required for individual farm soils to boost productivity sustainably.
schemes.benefits: Free soil test report issued every 2 years detailing 12 parameters (N, P, K, micro-nutrients, pH). Prevents over-fertilization.
schemes.application_process: Soil samples collected by local Agriculture Department officials; card issued through village panchayat or soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
